## Checklist
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO: `git commit -s`)
- [ ] CI, gitleaks and the safety scan pass
- [ ] No secrets, real data, or licensed standards text
- [ ] Wording: mapped to / aligned with / tested against; no "compliant" or "certified"
- [ ] Touches crypto, verifier or Egress Guard rules? Say so: it needs extra review
